changes.comment: Fix an issue where a rule reading a `$binding` or `prop()` did not apply its value again when an attribute or child change made it match again, so an inverse rule left the old value in place. Where two rules reach the same key, the later one now wins for bindings, as it does for literals.
Fix an issue where values indexed by `attr()`, such as `$names[attr("data-key")]`, did not update when the attribute changed
Add the key names `Space` / `Spacebar` and `plus` to `key:` in `@on` (`"Shift+Space"`); a `key:` holding only spaces now warns and names `Space`
Add absolute `http(s)` URLs to `@use`: the module loads from that URL (another origin needs CORS), and any other scheme (`data:`, `blob:`) is refused with a logged error
Add `QuarkLogger` to the exports of `@excom/quark`: `QuarkLogger.level = 2` shows the warnings Quark logs
